dedupe_keys.name: aktualni stav na povodnovych cidlech usteckeho kraje

description: Aktuální stav na povodňových čidlech Ústeckého kraje is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ústecký kraj. It contains the current water level in centimeters compared to the usually measured state. It also contains temperature in degrees Celsius and percentage humidity in the air, but we do not guarantee these values. Coverage: Ústecký kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Current state at flood sensors in the Ústí Region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ústecký kraj. Its keywords include povodňová čidla, Ústecký kraj, watercourses, flood sensors, vodní toky, Ústí Region. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70892156/4baf610f16b0b64976a0ffdd34a9880e/distribuce/d12c56bdf39bc0c1564a282db5ed68f1/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
